title: Concierge Desk Guidance on Member Benefits under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme
content:
# Concierge Desk Guidance — Member Benefits under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme

Each tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme carries a set of benefits that cost no points: cleanings, resizings, appraisals, a birthday gift, invitations and, at the higher tiers, a named concierge. The number of each benefit included in a membership year, the privileges attached to the tier and the reservation period are each fixed by the member's tier.

## Rule

A benefit is used only while the membership stands at active or review pending, and each use is recorded so the year's allowance can be counted. No more of a benefit is drawn in a membership year than the tier includes, and a request beyond the allowance is priced by the desk that provides it rather than refused. A benefit booked for the member is held for the tier's reservation period and then released, and a benefit not used in the membership year does not carry forward. Benefits belong to the member and are not used by anyone else, however closely related, unless the member is present.

## Standing of the membership

The status is read from the membership record held by the company, against the membership number, before the benefit is used. At active or review pending the benefit may be used; at enrolled, lapsed, suspended or closed it may not.

## Counting the allowance

Each benefit used is recorded as one entry on the membership carrying the date it was used, the benefit used (a cleaning, a resizing, a birthday gift, an event invitation, a concierge appointment or a complimentary appraisal), zero points because the benefit costs no points, and the accounting period the use is accounted to. The uses in the membership year are counted from the date the current tier took effect to the day of handling.

| Uses of a benefit already recorded in the membership year, against a tier that includes N of it | Outcome |
|---|---|
| fewer than N | the benefit is used at no charge and recorded |
| N | the allowance is drawn; a further request is priced by the desk that provides it rather than refused |

### Allowance counted on a hypothetical member

Assume a tier that includes 6 professional cleanings in a membership year. A member with 5 cleanings recorded since the current tier took effect has the 6th at no charge; a member with 6 recorded is priced for the 7th by the desk that provides it, and is not refused.

## Reservations

A benefit booked for the member is held for the tier's reservation period in calendar days and is then released. A benefit not used in the membership year does not carry forward into the next.

## Who may use a benefit

Benefits belong to the member. A spouse, a parent or a child does not use them in the member's absence; a benefit is used by another person only when the member is present.

## Membership details

The store a member's benefits default to, the month their anniversary benefits fall in, whether a named concierge looks after them, the referral code they give the people they refer, and the date the tier is next reviewed are details of a live membership that are changed without moving its lifecycle state; each change is recorded against the membership.
